Infinite-dimensional limits rely on analytic estimates, not finite sampling.

value.rationale: Answers a published structural problem for a canonical non-bounded-below sparse-spike operator family by determining the entire WOT and SOT omega-limit sets. Realizes arbitrary compact transversal sets K, including Cantor sets and intervals, and gives a topological separation theorem: all scalar asymptotic numerical ranges depend only on max K while cluster spaces can be nonhomeomorphic. This is an operator-level inverse realization result with a genuine loss-of-information phenomenon, not a renaming of the known disconnectedness witness.
